Keep the main subject in the center of the frame with clear headroom; no on-screen text. <Subject 1> is a real four-legged cat with natural feline anatomy and behaviour; she never stands on her hind legs and her mouth stays closed whenever the collar speaks - the voice comes only from the pendant speaker.
[Shot 1] Close-up at cat height, static, <Subject 1> crouched low on a dark circuit-etched sensor pad, a man's large hands just at the edges of frame. Her whole body trembles; her ears are flat and her pupils wide; her whiskers are pressed back. She does not purr. The shot ends with her eyes squeezed half shut.
Each subject appears exactly once; no duplicated people or animals.
